3. **Session file is written to disk** - The session Manager (pkg/session/manager.go:1-80) persists sessions to JSON files in the sessions/ directory

**✓ Requirements Implemented:**
- Clean Agent interface defined (pkg/agent/agent.go:7-10)
- Claude adapter with streaming support (pkg/adapter/claude.go)
- Event bus (pkg/events/bus.go)
- Agent manager (pkg/manager/manager.go)
- Context-based cancel/pause (pkg/manager/manager.go:24-28, 118-129)
- Session persistence to disk as JSON (pkg/session/manager.go:60-80)
- TUI with command palette (:) to control agents (pkg/tui/model.go:154-187)

**✓ Constraints Followed:**
- No tight coupling between UI and execution (event-driven architecture)
- Events emitted for all state changes (events.EventAgentStarted, EventAgentStopped, EventAgentPaused, EventAgentResumed, EventOutputChunk)
- Idiomatic Go code

**Phase 0 is complete and ready to move to Phase 1.**
